title: Actual-capital accounting, Morpho cbXRP ingestion and x402 attribution controls

decisions.decision: Treat Morpho cbXRP/USDC as a distinct Base collateral market. Store raw market id, chain id, token addresses, LLTV, oracle address, oracle price, total supply assets, total borrow assets, available liquidity, borrow/lend rates, timestamps and raw response hash.
decisions.validation: Reconcile API state against onchain contract state; reject inconsistent utilization arithmetic.

decisions.decision: Use Morpho REST GET endpoints for market discovery and state/rate history, then supplement with Base event logs and direct contract reads for position-level collateral, liquidations, repayment, transfers and oracle updates.
decisions.validation: No API request or ingestion job executed in this run.

decisions.decision: Do not attribute the entire public Morpho market to Coinbase. Maintain separate fields for Coinbase UI-originated loans, total Morpho market activity and unknown-origin positions.
decisions.validation: Require verified contract/event linkage or authorized Coinbase data.

decisions.decision: Model cbXRP reserve XRP and cbXRP supply as one underlying exposure; create an overlap group so Coinbase reserve addresses are not double-counted in exchange balances and DeFi supply.
decisions.validation: Crosswalk the 20 Coinbase reserve addresses against all 358 Coinbase-labeled exchange wallets.

decisions.decision: A liquidation-to-native-XRP sell-pressure event requires the full chain: Morpho seize -> liquidator cbXRP transfer -> Coinbase deposit -> unwrap -> native XRP credit -> confirmed sale/withdrawal. Do not infer sale from liquidation alone.
decisions.validation: Trace each liquidator and retain unresolved stages.

decisions.decision: Separate gross transfer volume, net external capital, stablecoin mint/burn, exchange wallet movements, ETF creations/redemptions, RWA registry/transferable float and collateral deposits/withdrawals.
decisions.validation: Each feature requires point-in-time provenance, overlap control and counterparty classification.

decisions.decision: x402 SourceTag is a merchant endpoint identifier, not an agent identity. Store payer account, merchant endpoint, invoice id, asset, amount, transaction hash and verified settlement separately.
decisions.validation: No agent identity may be inferred from SourceTag alone.

decisions.decision: Keep x402 counts separate from economic value. Measure XRP and RLUSD settlement amounts independently; calculate USD value only using timestamp-aligned prices and report net XRP acquisition separately.
decisions.validation: T54 vendor counters require on-ledger reconciliation and a neutral comparison series.

decisions.decision: Do not admit OI, liquidation heatmap, exchange balance, RWA registry, stablecoin supply or Morpho UI utilization into the prediction model until provider coverage, timestamps, overlaps and units reconcile.
Keep forecasts NOT_ISSUED until immutable fixed-horizon outcomes, point-in-time features, baseline comparisons, walk-forward evaluation and probability calibration pass.
decisions.validation: No directional forecast or real-money use.

next_actions: Fetch Morpho market list/state/history through public REST and preserve raw snapshots.
Reconcile Morpho market utilization and oracle scope against contract state.
Trace liquidator cbXRP transfers and Coinbase unwrap events.
Crosswalk Coinbase 20 reserve addresses against labeled exchange wallets.
Reconcile USDC/RLUSD per-chain supply and issuer accounts.
Build fixed-horizon outcomes and walk-forward evaluation before forecasting.
